title: Dārukkhandho
text: 1 Evam me sutaṃ || ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Kimbilāyaṃ viharati Gaṅgāya nadiyā tire || 2 Addasā kho Bhagavā mahantam dārukkhandhaṃ Gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānaṃ || disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi || || Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave amum mahantaṃ dārukkhandhaṃ Gaṅgāya nadiyā sotena vuyhamānan ti [page 182] 182 SAḶĀYATANA-SAṂYUTTA [XXXV. 201. 3 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] || || Evam bhante || || 3 Vitthāretabbaṃ || pe || || 4 Evaṃ vutte āyasma Kimbilo Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Kiṃ nu kho bhante orimantīram || || Vitthāretabbo || pe || 12 Katamo ca Kimbila antopūtibhāvo || || Idha Kimbila bhikkhu aññataraṃ saṅkiliṭṭham āpattim āpanno hoti yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānam paññāyati || ayaṃ vuccati Kimbila antopūtibhāvoti || ||
